title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 3
subtitle: He Said - She Said
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 3: He Said - She Said (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, Pete and I are meeting with a consultant who will help us with our new show. Yesterday, Pete had promised to meet me here at 8:00 am. but he did not come on time.
dialogue.zh: 今天皮特和我要見一位顧問，幫我們做新節目。昨天皮特答應早上 8 點在這兒見我，可他沒準時來。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Uh-oh. It’s bad to be late for a business meeting. But while we wait for Pete, let’s talk about a new verb tense -- past perfect! When we talk about two things in the past, we can use the past perfect for the first event. Put "had" before the past participle. "Pete had promised he would meet Anna." Find sentences with the past perfect tense. Remember, look for "had!"
dialogue.zh: 哦哦。商務會議遲到可不好。等皮特的時候，我們來學一個新時態——過去完成時！談兩件過去的事時，先發生的那件用過去完成時。在過去分詞前加 had。“Pete had promised he would meet Anna.”請找出過去完成時的句子。記住，找 had！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: You two are late -- exactly 43 minutes late! What happened?
dialogue.zh: 你們倆遲到了——整整晚了 43 分鐘！怎麼回事？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: He had to get his "special" coffee -- SPECIAL coffee!
dialogue.zh: 他非要去買他的“特製”咖啡——特製咖啡！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: She had to feed her birds -- HER birds!
dialogue.zh: 她非要去喂她的鳥——她的鳥！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Okay, I can see already that you need my help. You can’t both talk at the same time. You have to take turns. Alright, Anna, you go first.
dialogue.zh: 好，我已經看出來你們需要我幫忙。不能同時說話。要輪流。好，安娜，你先說。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure. Kelly, see, Pete and I live in the same building. So, we decided to meet at 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m. to come to work together. I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived!
dialogue.zh: 好。凱利，你看，皮特和我住同一棟樓。所以我們約好早上 8 點——8 點一起去上班。皮特到的時候，我已經等了 15 分鐘！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late. I left you a message.
dialogue.zh: 皮特浪費時間等咖啡之後，我們就遲到了。我給你留了言。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Hum. I didn’t get that message.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。我沒收到那條留言。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 哦。抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Pete?
dialogue.zh: 皮特？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna left a message. That’s the right thing to do. Did you find some examples of the past perfect sentences? I did. Anna said, "After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late." Look at that coffee! It looks more like dessert! Okay, keep watching for past perfect!
dialogue.zh: 安娜留了言。這樣做是對的。你找到過去完成時的例子了嗎？我找到了。安娜說：“After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late.”看看那杯咖啡！看起來更像甜點！好，繼續找過去完成時！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, that’s not why we’re late. This is why we’re late: I had arrived on time at 8:00 a.m. but didn’t see Anna. She was standing behind a tree. I think she was hugging it. I always walk to work. But she said that would take too long and that a scooter would be much faster. It was awful. I hated it. And it added too much time to our commute!
dialogue.zh: 對，我們遲到不是因為那個。原因是這樣：我早上 8 點準時到了，可沒看見安娜。她站在一棵樹後面。我覺得她在抱樹。我一向走路上班。可她說那樣太慢，滑板車會快得多。太糟了。我討厭它。還讓通勤更久！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Then Anna stopped by a pond to feed the birds. She had named them after characters from books and yelled the names out loud … Romeo! Juliet! Sherlock! By the time she had fed all the birds, we were late.
dialogue.zh: 然後安娜在池塘邊停下來喂鳥。她用書裡的人物給鳥起了名字，還大聲喊……羅密歐！朱麗葉！福爾摩斯！等她喂完所有的鳥，我們已經晚了。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: This is what I think. You two see the same event very differently. Does this happen often with you two?
dialogue.zh: 我是這麼想的。你們對同一件事看法很不一樣。你們倆經常這樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Okay. This is good. This is good! It’s good to see things differently. I have an idea: we will call the show "He Said, She Said." For every story, you tell a different point of view.
dialogue.zh: 好。這很好。這很好！看法不同是好事。我有個主意：節目就叫《他說，她說》。每個故事，你們講不同的角度。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is a great idea, Kelly! Pete, we are different. That’s why I thought of you for this job!
dialogue.zh: 好主意，凱利！皮特，我們不一樣。所以我才想到讓你做這份工作！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: I think you two understand perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得你們倆完全明白了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s get to work!
dialogue.zh: 開始幹活吧！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: She named the birds? Really?
dialogue.zh: 她給鳥起名字？真的？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah…

quiz.prompt: How late are Anna and Pete for the meeting?
What does Pete say made them late?
choices: Anna hugged a tree, took a scooter, and fed the birds
They could not find the studio

quiz.prompt: What will Anna and Pete's show be called?
